facts.text: All new undergraduates complete Foundation, a mandatory year-long immersive first-year program experimenting across various media before selecting a major.

sources.title: Majors + Minors - Kansas City Art Institute
sources.quote: Foundation is a year-long immersive experience for all new students. Here, you'll find your people, challenge artistic preconceptions, experiment with a variety of media, learn new skills, take creative risks and build the foundation for your creative education.
